project.name: VisaPathFinder
project.repositoryState: Scanned against the current working tree, including the uncommitted compare-content expansion, embassy refresh, and documentation/context updates.

overview.summary: A TanStack Start visa reference site that serves static country, visa, embassy, comparison, and tracker pages.
goals: Provide a local-only visa application tracker.

businessContext.purpose: Reference product for visa research and trip-planning support.
businessModelSignals: Site copy describes the product as free and ad-supported.

architecture.style: SSR React application with file-based routing and static TypeScript data modules.
architecture.rendering: Server-rendered with client and server bundles.
architecture.dataSource: Static in-repo TypeScript modules under src/data.
architecture.serverWrapper: src/server.ts adds canonical redirects, HSTS, and SSR error fallback handling.

implementedFeatures: Home page with country search and discovery sections.
Visa detail pages with checklist, sources, and JSON-LD.
Embassy dataset reviewed and refreshed against official/public sources on 2026-08-05.
Pairwise country comparison pages for all current country combinations.
Pair-specific compare-page narrative system generated from country profiles and pair briefs.
Browser-local visa tracker with share-link support.
Structured SEO metadata and sitemap generation.
Static robots, redirects, and security headers.
Ad slot component with optional AdSense script loading.
completedMilestones: Static content model established for the current 7-country scope.
SSR route set implemented for all visible product areas.
Long-form compare-content system added to the working tree.
Compare-page similarity reduced materially versus the legacy template according to the local comparison script run on 2026-08-05.
Tracker feature implemented without account requirements.
